reviewer.notes: Fresh-context independent review of AUD-0047 path-filter audit. Goal: FALSIFY headline filtered_workflow_count=0 / live_hole_count=0 / planted_miss_caught=True / vacuous_no_filter=12 on the declared scan surface (.github/workflows/*.yml). Could not. Re-ran both named probes; raw outputs byte-identical to committed. Independent census of all 12 root workflows: zero literal (non-comment) paths:/paths-ignore: keys; extract_event_path_filters empty for every on.push/pull_request/pull_request_target block (cfg keys are branches/types only). All 12 hit PyYAML on:→True quirk; load_workflow remaps it — planted fixture also uses True-key and would silently report hole_count=0 without the remap, so the control proves the quirk fix is load-bearing. Planted paths-ignore fixture yields 4 holes including command-center/receipt_validate.py on push and pull_request (planted_miss_caught=True). Synthetic injection of paths-ignore into a quality.yml-shaped copy and a paths-allowlist miss both fire the detector. No dorny/paths-filter or job-level path if: signals in root workflows (residual_unknown job-level remains NOT-CHECKED, does not move headline). Vendor/extra trees: ralph/metaswarm have no path filters; node_modules/fast-uri has paths-ignore but is outside probe1 glob and shows holes=0 against its own inferred set. Did not promote receipt to SUCCESS / did not run packer ADMIT; leaving promotion to parent. Only this independent-review.json is intended to be committed.
